nodes.text:
Everything I sell has been under. Don't let that put you off - under is where the good plate is.

I pull it, I strip it, I make it fit someone breathing.

I loot the drowned who've stopped needing it. There's a difference, and I'm careful about it, whatever Corrin says when he's had a drink.

A Legionary who still walks his route keeps his plate. One that's finally lain down does not. I've never taken a piece off something that could still object.
